nodes.label: Categorize the ticket based on its description. Possible categories are: "Technical Issue", "Billing Question", "Feature Request", "Account Management", "Other".
Assess the urgency of the ticket. Possible urgency levels are: "High", "Medium", "Low".  A "High" urgency ticket indicates a critical system outage or immediate user impact.

Assign the ticket to the appropriate team based on the category.
* "Technical Issue" -> "Engineering Team"
* "Billing Question" -> "Billing Team"
* "Feature Request" -> "Product Team"
* "Account Management" -> "Account Support Team"
* "Other" -> "General Support Team"
Format your response as a JSON object with the following keys: "category", "urgency", and "team".
{{ ticket.description }} contains "critical error" or "{{ ticket.description }}" contains "system outage".
